data.title: prime --json caps free text at 2000 characters and reports the full size
data.why: The payload carried full text on the reasoning that an agent has no line to fit and cannot expand an ellipsis it is given. That holds for prose a person wrote and stops holding at 200 KB, where one note made the preamble 200,728 bytes while the text output stayed at 578. Capping at 2000 leaves every real note untouched — the journal's own run 285 characters at the median and 642 at the longest — and notes[] now carries bytes with the full length, the same signal documentation already gives, so a cut note is still known about and fetchable with note list.
data.rejected: Carrying full text, the original design: it makes the one command written to a budget the thing it exists to prevent.; Capping at the text output's 60 characters: an agent has no line to fit, and that would cut every real note for the sake of a pathological one.
